description: Related keywords for a seed from Google's 'searches related to' graph, to a depth of 0-4, each with search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty and search intent; up to 100 in one $0.04 call (Google Ads data). Use when you need topic clusters around a keyword. Each row has its depth and the further related searches. No matches returns empty results (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.04 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

depth.description: How many levels of the related-searches graph to traverse (0-4). Defaults to 1.

keyword.description: Seed keyword (at most 80 characters; whitespace, control characters and case are normalised; a seed then empty, over 10 words or over 80 characters is a free 400).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Defaults to en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

limit.description: Maximum keywords to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

locationCode.description: Google Ads location code (geo target ID). Defaults to 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States, market.fallback).

name: related_keywords
title: Related keywords (up to 100, depth 0-4)
